test_title: SSC Selection Post Matric Level Official Paper (Held on: 2 Feb 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Seven boys Ajay, Mihir, Rohit, Karan, Vaibhav, Nitin and Sanjay are sitting on a straight bench facing towards the north. Karan is sitting at the extreme left end and second to the left of Rohit. Mihir is the immediate neighbour of Rohit and Vaibhav. Nitin is sitting to the immediate left of Sanjay.

Who is sitting second to the left of Mihir?
solution:
**Seven boys: **Ajay, Mihir, Rohit, Karan, Vaibhav, Nitin and Sanjay are sitting on a straight bench facing towards the north.

1) Karan is sitting at the extreme left end and second to the left of Rohit.

2) Mihir is the immediate neighbour of Rohit and Vaibhav.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/daade18c0e2cf9ab86dde05ad1a3ffa1b8052e24c5f1a25a56ec397c16b743fa.png] 

3) Nitiin is sitting to the immediate left of Sanjay.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e23ff49536c1cc595bd423f9231f68463008f7a45e2ca292d23541488ede86e8.png] Clearly, Ajay sitting second to the left of Mihir.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Ajay".**
